product_overview: REX is a local-first research workstation for ML/AI experimentation that helps technical users create research runs, execute and inspect experiments, and trace claims back to deterministic evidence. The interface emphasizes auditability, verification, and reproducible research over chat-based assistance.
core_goals: Create a research run from a computational ML/AI research question
Monitor research progress across lifecycle stages
Inspect experiment specifications, execution history, metrics, and logs
Trace claims back to supporting evidence and lineage
Read generated research reports with evidence grounding
Verify research artifacts and claim support deterministically
Inspect and manage generated artifacts and system settings

features.name: Research Investigation Management
features.description: Create new research investigations, browse existing runs, and open a run to inspect its current stage and details.
user_flows: Navigate to /research -> Open the new investigation flow -> Enter a research question -> Select a domain -> Create the investigation -> See the new research run appear in the list
Navigate to /research -> Review the list of research runs -> Filter or scan by status -> Open a research run -> See the run detail view with stage progression and investigation context

features.name: Research Lifecycle Control
features.description: Control the progress of a research run and inspect its live telemetry during execution.
user_flows: Navigate to /research -> Open a research run -> Start the run -> See the lifecycle begin and stage progression update
Navigate to /research/:id -> Open the live telemetry drawer -> Inspect streaming events from the research run
Navigate to /research/:id -> Pause the run -> Resume the run -> See the run continue through the next stage

features.name: Experiment Detail & Metric Progression
features.description: Inspect an experiment’s objective, parameters, execution history, metric trends, and logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /experiments -> Browse the experiment catalog -> Open an experiment -> See its objective, specification, execution history, and metric progression
Navigate to /experiments/:id -> Review the metric chart -> Switch between stdout and stderr logs -> Search or filter log lines -> Inspect the execution output

features.name: Side-by-Side Experiment Comparison
features.description: Compare multiple experiments to understand parameter differences, metric changes, and reproducibility signals.
user_flows: Navigate to /experiments/compare -> Select two or more experiments -> Compare the experiments -> See parameter diffs, metric deltas, and reproducibility assessment
Navigate to /experiments/compare -> Select experiments with differing outcomes -> Compare the experiments -> Review which metrics improved or regressed

features.name: Deterministic Evidence Lineage Tracing
features.description: Browse claims and inspect deterministic lineage from claims back through results, runs, experiments, and hypotheses.
user_flows: Navigate to /evidence -> Browse the claims list -> Open a claim’s lineage -> See the vertical evidence chain from claim to hypothesis
Navigate to /evidence/lineage/:claimId -> Inspect the DAG nodes -> Open node details in the inspection drawer -> Trace how the claim is supported by evidence

features.name: Scientific Report Viewer
features.description: Browse generated reports and open a report to read the full research summary, structured sections, and grounding status.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Browse generated reports -> Open a report -> Read the executive summary, methodology, experiment matrix, and metrics tables
Navigate to /reports -> Open a report -> Review unsupported claim warnings if present -> Download the report as Markdown or JSON

features.name: Artifact Inspection & Cryptographic Verification
features.description: Browse generated artifacts, verify integrity hashes, preview file contents, and download files.
user_flows: Navigate to /artifacts -> Browse the artifact catalog -> Filter by file type -> Verify an artifact hash -> See a valid or tampered integrity status
Navigate to /artifacts -> Open an artifact preview -> Inspect the text or code content -> Download the artifact
Navigate to /artifacts -> Verify an artifact hash -> Review the SHA-256 result -> Confirm whether the file is intact

features.name: Global Command Palette
features.description: Use keyboard-driven search to quickly jump to pages, runs, and experiments.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the command palette -> Type a search query -> Move through results -> Open the selected page or record
Navigate to / -> Open the command palette -> Search for a run or experiment -> Select a result -> Jump directly to that item

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Toggle the application between light and dark appearance modes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme -> See the interface switch between light and dark modes
Navigate to /settings or / -> Toggle the theme -> Reopen the app later -> See the preferred theme persist across sessions

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: View and update system configuration values such as timeout and tolerance settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review current configuration values -> Edit timeout and tolerance fields -> Save the settings -> See a confirmation message
Navigate to /settings -> Modify configuration values -> Save the settings -> Reopen settings to confirm the updated values remain in place

routes.description: System overview dashboard displaying active research runs, quick actions, metric trends, and system status
List of all scientific research investigations with status filters and new run creation modal
Research run detail view with stage progression stepper, control buttons, hypotheses, experiments, claims, and telemetry drawer
Catalog of designed and executed experiments with status, runs count, and navigation
Experiment detail view showing parameter specifications, execution history table, metric progression SVG chart, and stdout/stderr tabs
Side-by-side comparison of two or more experiments with parameter diffs, metric deltas, and reproducibility analysis
Evidence hub displaying formulated claims, epistemic confidence levels, verification status, and lineage inspection links
Deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) tracing claims to results, execution runs, experiments, and root hypotheses
Catalog of generated evidence-grounded scientific research reports
Full research report viewer with executive summary, methodology, experiment matrix, metrics table, and citation verification
Formal verification portal to audit research runs for numerical tolerance, claim support, and empirical reproducibility
Artifact directory browser with file size, SHA-256 checksum inspector, tamper detection validation, and preview modal
System configuration and runtime settings manager with save/reset controls

features.name: Research Investigation Management
features.description: Create and monitor end-to-end scientific research investigations
user_interactions: Click New Investigation button to open modal
Input research question and select domain
Click Create Investigation to submit
View list of research runs with current stage badges
Click a research run to view detail

features.name: Research Lifecycle Control
features.description: Transition research runs through automated state machine stages
user_interactions: Click Start Run button to begin investigation
Click Pause button to temporarily halt execution
Click Resume button to continue execution
Open Live Telemetry drawer to inspect streaming event log

features.name: Experiment Detail & Metric Progression
features.description: Inspect experiment parameters, execution runs, metric trends, and execution logs
user_interactions: View objective and specification parameters
Inspect SVG line chart of progression metrics
Switch between stdout and stderr log tabs
Filter and search execution log lines

features.name: Side-by-Side Experiment Comparison
features.description: Compare multiple experiments to analyze parameter differences and metric improvements
user_interactions: Select two or more experiments from checkboxes or dropdown
Click Compare Experiments button
View parameter diff table
Inspect metric delta table with color-coded improvement/regression badges
Check reproducibility assessment score

features.name: Deterministic Evidence Lineage Tracing
features.description: Deterministic DAG visualization connecting claims to empirical evidence
user_interactions: Browse claims list with epistemic verification badges
Click View Lineage button on a claim
Interact with vertical DAG nodes representing Claim, Result, Run, Experiment, and Hypothesis
Click a DAG node to view details in the inspection drawer

features.name: Scientific Report Viewer
features.description: Read and verify evidence-grounded research reports
user_interactions: Browse list of generated reports with grounding badges
Click on a report to view full markdown and structured sections
Inspect unsupported claims warnings if empirical grounding is missing
Click Download Markdown or Download JSON buttons

features.name: Artifact Inspection & Cryptographic Verification
features.description: Browse generated artifacts and verify cryptographic SHA-256 integrity
user_interactions: Browse artifacts catalog with file type filters
Click Verify Hash button to execute on-disk SHA-256 checksum check
See valid green badge or tampered red alert badge
Click Preview button to open text/code preview drawer
Click Download button to retrieve file

features.name: Global Command Palette
features.description: Keyboard-driven fuzzy search and rapid navigation across the workstation
user_interactions: Press Ctrl+K or Cmd+K to open palette modal
Type search query to filter pages, runs, and experiments
Use arrow keys to navigate results
Press Enter to navigate to selected item
Press Escape to close modal

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Toggle between Dark and Light mode
user_interactions: Click Sun/Moon theme toggle icon in top bar
UI theme toggles instantly between light and dark modes
Preference persists across browser sessions in localStorage

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: View and configure system parameters and resource limits
user_interactions: View database path, timeout thresholds, and sandbox execution settings
Modify timeout and tolerance fields
Click Save Settings button
See confirmation toast notification
